<thought>The ^1H NMR spectrum shows three singlet peaks with integrations of 3 H, 6 H, and 6 H. Each integration corresponds to methyl (CH₃) protons: 3 H = one CH₃, 6 H = two equivalent CH₃ groups, and another 6 H = two more equivalent CH₃ groups. Summing them gives 1 + 2 + 2 = 5 methyl groups.</thought>
<final_answer>5</final_answer>
